cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your shadow moved before you. What changed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was thinking of leaving, but I can't find the exit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Think about that bench without moving. Does it turn?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's gone to the bench. I'm still here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It seems to follow your intentions. Think about the exit again; let's follow slowly and see whether it knows the way.

mechanism: A uses its pupil old one-change observation exercise to test whether an independently moving shadow follows thoughts, then cautiously applies that rule to finding an exit.
confusable: Not simply accepting a magical guide: A forms and tests a specific causal hypothesis before trusting it with navigation.
comparison: Soup direction control versus intentions controlling a shadow.
seedUse: D150 early shadow/exit/bench/thought/slow following; S05 stationary observation practice.
